I accidentally misdosed Solandra:
I'm a guy who usually collects psychoactive plants on the street and I usually research them. I was collecting some coca leaves on the street in Florida and I had also collected some Solandra grandiflora cuttings. So when I got home, I just let the plants dry for a few days for a weekend of drinking beer and chewing coca leaves.
While chewing coca leaves, I realized that Solandra had been dropping some leaves and they are similar to those of coca when they are dry. Then, when I was chewing, I didn't realize it, but the effect was starting to be somewhat strangely bitter. My mouth started to dry out. I felt slightly dizzy. The nausea from the coca had disappeared, and I was also feeling dizzy. So I stopped chewing and realized that I had been chewing the coca leaves with Solandra.
The effect was starting to rise like a hurricane and I lay down to wear off the effects, my throat felt dry, my fingers were trembling and I was generally cold, then I looked in the mirror and saw how my pupils were dilated, then I started to have visions with my eyes closed since I was in a state of wakefulness and I had dreams with many meanings, it took me 3 days in total until I was able to recover, I had blurred vision, dry mouth, stimulated, I also went through those 3 days in a state of sleep with difficulty swallowing.
